verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents its own app lock. A custom lock screen supports PINs and passwords, and FaceID lock can be enabled under Settings → Security → Lockscreen. Together these cover both the biometric and the PIN parts of the story. Missing for 10: no in-depth first-party docs on the lock behavior (auto-lock timing, which platforms support biometrics), and no independent or hands-on corroboration that the lock protects codes on a borrowed phone.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes

citations.quote: You can now further protect your codes with a custom lock screen that supports PINs and passwords.
You can enable FaceID lock under Settings → Security → Lockscreen.
